toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma comes before it.

toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Droë hout vat vinnig vlam' and 'die vuur gee ook lig' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: diep onder die grond en ander is
toegepas.na: diep onder die grond, en ander is

toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Party myne is ...' and 'ander is ...' are two clauses with their own subject and verb.

toegepas.na: vir lig en om kos gaar te maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vir kos' is vague (it reads as if paraffin were food); the lesson already uses 'kos gaar maak' for cooking.
toegepas.fout: 'vir kos' is vague and can read as if paraffin were used as food.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'om kos gaar te maak' states the intended use plainly, matches the lesson's own phrase, and adds no new fact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence opens with 'hierdie brandstowwe' (plural), so the singular 'die brandstof se' does not agree with what it refers to.
toegepas.fout: Singular 'die brandstof se' does not agree with the plural 'hierdie brandstowwe' it refers back to.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plural fixes the reference without touching the protected 'al die energie wat uitkom' or the term 'uitsetenergie'.

toegepas.voor: Die vlam binne die enjin gee wel lig. Ons kan daardie lig nie gebruik nie.
toegepas.na: Die vlam binne die enjin gee wel lig, maar ons kan daardie lig nie gebruik nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wel' sets up a contrast that the choppy second sentence leaves hanging; joining with 'maar' makes the contrast explicit without new content.
toegepas.fout: The contrast set up by 'wel' is left hanging across two choppy sentences.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Joining with ', maar' makes the existing contrast explicit with the AWS comma, keeps the sentence short, and changes no meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The same sentence says 'die liggaam se brandstof'; 'liggaam' keeps the reference consistent and suits the register better than 'lyf'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'lyf' is plain, natural Afrikaans and varies the repeated 'liggaam'; the swap is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die hout begin nie vanself brand nie en wag maande lank in die skuur.
laat_vaar.na: Die hout wag maande lank in die skuur en begin nie vanself brand nie.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting the waiting first and the 'does not start burning by itself' second reads more logically and naturally, with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original already reads clearly and leads with its point; the reorder only reads differently.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'uit die grond uithaal' doubles the 'uit'; 'uit die grond haal' is cleaner and keeps the protected 'uit die grond'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'uit die grond uithaal' is the normal Afrikaans doubled particle construction, not an error; the change is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: Baie van hulle gee vir ons ook lig
laat_vaar.na: Baie van hulle gee ons ook lig
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'gee ons ook lig' is smoother and matches the next sentence's 'gee ons hitte en beweging'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'gee vir ons' is standard, natural Afrikaans; dropping 'vir' is a lateral move.
